en.headline: sogeisetsu: 23 own commits in sopen-translate plus 21 automated commits
en.summary: The day's work was concentrated in `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`, with **23 own commits** and no pull requests, reviews, issues, or releases. Provider work added two options: a keyless Google web endpoint as an unverified preset, and Microsoft MT together with an optional LLM review pass; protocol-id lookups now use own-property checks. Performance changes made translation viewport-first, translating the visible area and continuing on scroll, and capped viewport batches so the first translation lands sooner; the review budget is now capped per page rather than per batch. Planning docs recorded Microsoft MT and optional review acceptance, viewport-first acceptance with the batch-shape fix, and an assessment of proxy options for Index-Translate by user experience. Separately, the profile repo `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` received 21 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. Overall totals were 23 commits.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu：sopen-translate 有 23 次本人提交，另有 21 次自动提交
zh.summary: 当天的工作集中在 `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`，共有 **23 次本人提交**，没有 pull request、review、issue 或 release。提供方方面新增两个选项：将无密钥的 Google 网页端点作为未验证预设，以及 Microsoft MT 配合可选的 LLM 审校流程；协议 id 查找改为仅检查自有属性。性能上改为视口优先翻译，先翻译可见区域并在滚动时继续，同时限制视口批次，让首次翻译更快出现；审校预算改为按页限制而非按批次。计划文档记录了 Microsoft MT 与可选审校的验收、视口优先与批次形态修复的验收，以及按用户体验评估 Index-Translate 的代理方案。此外，个人主页仓库 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 有 21 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 完成的自动提交。总体共计 23 次提交。
